prose: A short antirez post titled 'Reasoning models are just LLMs.' Only the title was captured, so this summary rests on it alone.

On that basis: Sanfilippo argues there is no new species here - 'reasoning' models are the same LLM machinery with different training or inference scaffolding, not a qualitative break. His supporting points are unknown from the capture.
highlights: antirez: reasoning models are just LLMs
Against treating chain-of-thought models as a new kind of system
Title only; the argument's substance unknown
